verdict.rationale: Sandboxed execution has some support. A community user reports that AutoGen runs agent-generated code in a fresh Docker container by default, and AutoGen Studio docs say teams can run in a docker container. Nothing in the pack shows fine-grained tool permissions, such as per-agent tool allowlists or approval policies. Missing for 10: documented fine-grained tool permission controls, first-party docs on sandboxed code-execution configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation.
